coordinate_system.time_scale: UTC labels; Horizons states requested in ICRF with Horizons' internal TDB integration

provenance.approximation_notes: JPL Horizons Chandrayaan-3 propulsion-module ephemeris sampled every five minutes to resolve its eccentric Earth orbits. The first 17 minutes of ascent are modeled between the launch site and first available state; the lander descent is not part of this path.
